issue.title: Reconcile shipped agy catalog with live agy models (1.3.5 vs models.yml)
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/llm_provider/models.yml` (`providers.agy`)

On 2026-10-14, `agy --version` reports `1.3.5` and `agy models` prints only:

```
gemini-3.8-flash-{high,medium,low}
claude-opus-5-5-{low,medium,high}
claude-sonnet-5-5-{low,medium,high}
gpt-oss-120b-medium
```

The shipped catalog still lists Gemini 3.7/3.6/3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, and `claude-opus-4-6-thinking`, plus (after Gemini 4 Argon landing) `gemini-4-argon-{high,medium,low}`. It does not list the live Claude 5.5 families.

This host cannot use Argon or the older Gemini families through `agy --model`; headless `agy` exits 1 rather than falling back. Official Antigravity docs list Argon, so the drift may be account-dependent (Google AI Ultra vs this install) rather than a simple stale-slug cleanup.

Related closed task sase-wl tracked only retired Gemini 3.5 Flash slugs on agy 1.1.26, when 3.7/3.6/3.1 Pro were still live. Do not treat this as that narrower removal.

Investigate whether the catalog should track account-visible models, keep a superset, add a doctor/parity check (`agy models` vs `models.yml`), and how to add Claude 5.5 without breaking accounts that do not see those slugs.

Anyone picking a catalog slug this `agy` does not serve gets a failed launch. Anyone looking for Claude 5.5 in the picker will not find the live slugs.

task_type_fields.impact: Picker and %model completion offer slugs this host's agy rejects, omit live Claude 5.5 variants, and the agy large/small tier default gemini-3.7-flash-* is not in local agy models.
task_type_fields.repro:
agy --version
agy models
python -c "from sase.llm_provider.model_manifest import provider_model_names; print('\n'.join(provider_model_names('agy')))"

issue.creation_reason: Gemini 4 Argon landing left a wider Antigravity catalog mismatch unfixed: local agy 1.3.5 neither lists Argon nor several still-shipped Gemini families, and it advertises Claude 5.5 slugs SASE does not catalog.
